decisions_log.decision: Used Tailwind's focus:not-sr-only combined with focus:absolute, focus:top-4, focus:left-4, focus:z-50 to reveal the skip link on focus.
decisions_log.rationale: The spec listed the exact Tailwind utility classes as a deferred decision; focus:not-sr-only is the idiomatic Tailwind v3+ approach that reverses sr-only on focus. This satisfies all three ACs without custom CSS.

decisions_log.decision: Placed <SkipLink /> as the first child of <body> in layout.tsx, before <ThemeProvider>.
decisions_log.rationale: ThemeProvider wraps the header and other navigation elements. Placing SkipLink outside ThemeProvider keeps it as the absolute first focusable DOM element, satisfying the Must requirement and the SWE constraint.

decisions_log.decision: Made the <main> element's tabindex not set (no tabIndex=-1 added).
decisions_log.rationale: Modern browsers move focus to anchor targets without requiring tabIndex=-1 on the target element. The spec does not require it and adding it would change tab order unexpectedly. If focus management proves unreliable in certain browsers, adding tabIndex=-1 to the <main> element would be a small follow-up.
